source.how: Director's own router and serializer run over ASGI against an in-memory job table; the rows' progress is Composer's envelope (CONTRACT 1.1) projected by Director's own project_progress. scripts/fixtures/template-progress/capture-director-template-progress.py regenerates this file. No network, no key, no model call, no deck text.

converting.what: Just uploaded: converting (no slide count yet, no as-is template)

checking.what: Placed, checking capacity: the as-is template is not saved yet

as-is-ready-mid-lock.what: As-is template saved, 30 slides, locking 10 locked / 4 analysed / 2 analysing / 14 queued; new topics still processing

locking-unlockable-kept.what: Locking, 12 slides: slide 6 unlockable and kept as-is (LOW_CONFIDENCE); new topics still processing

done-available.what: Done: every slide locked, new topics available

done-available-one-kept.what: Done: slide 6 kept as-is (PK 13 Oct: it does not block), new topics available

paused-budget-done.what: Done but locking paused: today's analysis budget used up (retryable)

locking.message: Locking paused: today's analysis budget is used up. Reuse as-is works now.

paused-budget-live.what: Locking paused while the job still runs (live locking.state paused)

locking.message: Locking paused: today's analysis budget is used up. Reuse as-is works now.

locking-failed-done.what: Job complete (as-is usable) but Composer failed after the as-is save: locking failed, retryable

locking.message: Locking could not finish. Reuse as-is works now.

refused-done.what: Done, metadata refused (SEMANTIC_D10_SLIDES_UNLOCKABLE): new topics refused, as-is usable

locking.message: Locking could not finish. Reuse as-is works now.

failed-upload.what: The upload failed before any template was saved (Director's own text)

errors: Template upload could not be completed; no automatic retry was made.

stalled-locking.what: Locking with no heartbeat for 200 s: poll.stalled

stalled-converting.what: Converting with no heartbeat for 200 s, no template saved: poll.stalled

legacy-running.what: Composer without its flag: no progress ever received (template_progress null), job running

legacy-complete.what: Composer without its flag: job complete, no progress ever received

new-topic-flag-disabled.what: Done, but Director's own new-topic flag is off

flag-off-running.what: Director flag off (COMPOSER_TEMPLATE_PROGRESS_ENABLED unset): the row as it was before the flow, no new fields

flag-off-complete.what: Director flag off: a completed upload job, the row as before
